title: Payment and onboarding

transcript.content: What happens after I pay for a TaxSimba package?

After you choose a TaxSimba service, the usual steps are: (1) create an account at https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/register, (2) verify your email, (3) select the Self Assessment or Making Tax Digital package that fits, (4) complete payment on the TaxSimba portal, (5) open your dashboard, then (6) follow the accountant-led onboarding steps shown there. I won’t invent portal screens or claim payment succeeded from this chat. Self Assessment packages: https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/self-assessment · MTD: https://www.taxsimba.co.uk/making-tax-digital.
When do I get dashboard access?

You typically gain access to your TaxSimba dashboard immediately after completing your registration and payment for a package. Once registered, you'll receive an email confirmation, and you can log in to the dashboard to start using the services. If you encounter any issues, please check your spam folder for the confirmation email or reach out to support.

Your accountant is assigned automatically by the TaxSimba system based on your selected package and specific needs. Once you complete your registration and payment, you'll be matched with an accountant who will assist you through the process. You can communicate with your assigned accountant through the dashboard for any queries or support you need.

Onboarding with TaxSimba typically takes a few days, depending on your specific circumstances and the complexity of your tax situation. After you register and pay, you'll receive guidance from your assigned accountant, who will help you set up your account and gather necessary information. If you have all your documents ready, the process can be quicker. If you have any specific concerns or timelines, feel free to ask!
